awards.name: IB Diploma Predicted 43/45 (HL: English A, History, Anthropology; SL: French B, Math AA, Biology)

rationale.intuition: Columbia RD intl admit 2.46% — among the lowest of T10. IB 43/45 places student in top ~3% of IB diploma cohort globally, normalized to ~3.95 unweighted 4.0 (43→3.95 per IBO→GPA conversion tables). Swiss nationality and humanities/social science profile differentiates from Asian STEM bucket. Columbia is not need-blind for intl, adding affordability pressure. SAT 1520 below 25th-percentile (1510) → marginal. Industry: T10 RD IB strong intl cluster 3-10%.

sources.name: Columbia CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Overall admit 3.86%; intl admit 2.46%. Not need-blind for intl applicants.

sources.name: IBO Statistical Bulletin May 2024 + IIE Open Doors
sources.evidence: IB 43/45 corresponds to ~top 3% of diploma cohort (mean ~30, SD ~5); standard AO conversion: 42-45 → 3.9-4.0 unweighted equivalent.

sources.name: Crimson Education IB Benchmark 2024
sources.evidence: IB diploma students (40+) at T10 RD cluster 3-12% admit; humanities/social science profiles benefit from differentiation outside saturated Asian STEM bucket.
